security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A local LLM server for the apps on this computer
bundle.longDescription: Pitwall runs local language models and serves them to your apps on 127.0.0.1 only: it loads and releases models by memory pressure, queues requests by priority, and shows what is running. A server process keeps serving when the window is closed.
